title: Kenyon Sadiq thought he was being pranked when Jets called to draft him

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kenyon Sadiq thought he was being pranked when Jets called to draft him
sources.description: The prank call that Shedeur Sanders received during the 2025 draft made Kenyon Sadiq wary when he got a call from the Jets during the first round on Thursday night.
